title: Transport, Communication, and Trade: Connecting People and Markets

questions.question: The Golden Quadrilateral connects which four metropolitan cities?
questions.rationale: The Golden Quadrilateral is a roughly 5,800 km express loop joining Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, and Kolkata.

questions.question: Under India's highway numbering, odd-numbered National Highways generally run:
questions.rationale: Odd numbers mark north-south routes increasing from east to west, while even numbers mark east-west routes increasing from north to south.

questions.question: India's first passenger train ran in 1853 between:
questions.rationale: On 16 April 1853 the first train covered the 34 km from Bori Bunder in Bombay to Thane.

questions.question: The broad gauge of Indian Railways measures:
questions.rationale: Broad gauge is 1.676 m; metre gauge is 1.000 m and narrow gauge about 0.762 m, all converging under Project Unigauge.

questions.question: National Waterway-1, about 1,620 km long, runs along which river?
questions.rationale: NW-1 stretches from Prayagraj to Haldia on the Ganga; NW-2 is on the Brahmaputra and NW-3 in Kerala.

questions.question: Which is India's largest natural harbour?
questions.rationale: Mumbai port is the largest natural harbour; Nhava Sheva beside it handles the most containers.

questions.question: Roughly what share of India's overseas trade by volume moves by sea?
questions.rationale: Ocean shipping carries around 95 percent of trade by volume, which is why ports sit at the heart of trade policy.

questions.question: The Hazira-Vijaipur-Jagdishpur (HVJ) pipeline is famous for carrying:
questions.rationale: The HVJ system moves natural gas from Hazira across the country, feeding fertilizer and industrial units.

questions.question: The six-digit PIN code of the Indian postal system was introduced in:
questions.rationale: The Postal Index Number code dates to 1972; its digits run from region and sub-region to the sorting district and post office.

questions.question: Which single item tops India's import bill?
questions.rationale: Crude petroleum is the largest import, a key reason the goods trade balance stays negative despite strong exports.
